messages:
marcus: Heads-up — onboarding two new Dedicated GPU pools next month (eu-west1 + us-west2). We’re hitting a wall with assignable public IPs and ENI limits in several cloud accounts. Need to open quota requests across orgs.
priya: Can you paste the concrete quotas we need per account? I can file support tickets. :+1:
marcus: Yep. TL;DR: burst of 120 extra public IPs in eu-west1 (for stress canaries + canary GPU nodes), 80 extra in us-west2, increase ENI per-instance limit from 4->8 for the GPU instance type in both regions, and request higher VPC ephemeral IP allocation for our autoscale pools.
daniel: Are these EIPs (static) or ephemeral ephemeral external IPs? Cloud provider will treat them differently.
marcus: Mostly ephemeral (auto-assigned) but we need some static reserved for control-plane NAT gateways and build agents — say 8 reserved in each region. So request: 200 assignable external IPs eu-west1 (includes 8 reserved), 120 us-west2 (includes 8 reserved).
priya: Ok. For filing: please give me project IDs, billing account numbers, and preferred justification text. Also add a note about GPU fleet launch date and safety margin (we usually ask for 2-3x headroom).
marcus: Project IDs: redwood-prod-eu, redwood-dedicated-us. Billing: 1234-5678-90 (EU), 9876-5432-10 (US). Justification (pasteable): "Launching Dedicated GPU pools for inference. Each GPU node requires an attachable ENI and may need an ephemeral public IP for health checks and external callbacks. We forecast peak 600 nodes across regions; request temporary headroom to ensure capacity during canary and ramp. Need quota by 2026-04-20."
priya: Thanks — filing now. Filing note: "Request increase of Compute Engine External IP addresses quota from 50->200 in redwood-prod-eu (eu-west1) and 40->120 in redwood-dedicated-us (us-west2). Also request increase of network interfaces per instance quota for N2/N2D GPU flavor from 4->8. Attach justification and link to spike deck."
sre-bot: Ticket created: GCP-42381. Estimated response: 72 hours. Tracker: https://cloudsupport.example/tickets/GCP-42381
daniel: Also pinging AWS accounts — our multi-cloud plan has a few workers in aws-prod-eu and aws-gpu-us. AWS needs EIP headroom and ENI per-subnet increases.
marcus: Right — for AWS: open support case to increase Elastic IP quota in eu-west-1 to +150 and in us-west-2 to +100. Also request ENI quota per-interface and per-subnet: allow 300 extra ENIs in the GPU subnets so we can attach IPs for node bootstrapping.
priya: Filing AWS now. Sample justification: "Expanding Dedicated GPU nodepools; autoscaler will create short-lived nodes which require public IP assignment for telemetry and external control traffic. Request temporary quota to avoid launch failures during rollout."
ops-oncall: Quick question — do we want IPv6 SLAAC/assignable addresses instead of bumping v4? Could help long term but some customers need v4.
marcus: Good call — we’ll request IPv6 allocation in eu-west1 as a follow-up. For this rollout we need v4 for compatibility; but open a separate RFC to evaluate IPv6-only paths for internal telemetry.
priya: AWS ticket: AWS-98765 created, case owners assigned. ETA initial reply 48h. Adding escalation note to ask for faster review (launch timeline 2026-04-22).
daniel: Linking the infra change list:
```
- add 200 external IP quota eu-west1
- add 120 external IP quota us-west2
- reserve 8 static IPs per region
- raise ENI per-instance to 8 for GPU flavors
- add 300 extra ENIs for GPU subnets (aws)
- follow-up RFC on IPv6 assignment
```
marcus: Thanks everyone. Priya — after tickets acked, please coordinate with eng-runtime for nodepool rollout window. I’ll update the launch playbook with the ticket IDs and rollback plan. :rocket:
priya: Will do. I’ll post updates in this thread and the launch channel.
ops-oncall: Noted — I’ll keep oncall slack+pager on standby the week of rollout.
marcus: Last note — cost estimate for additional EIPs/ENIs: expect ~$1.2k/month across regions for reserved mappings during peak. Added to the finance forecast.
priya: Filed and bookmarked tickets, closing loop later with support responses. :white_check_mark:
